STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_069621.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

Read input: origen_069621.v · Open raw
module origen_069621 (
    input CLOCK_50,
    input [1:0] KEY,
    output [7:0] LED,
    output I2C_SCLK,
    inout I2C_SDAT,
    output [6:0] SD_COUNTER_OUT,
    output [9:0] COUNT
);

    reg [6:0] SD_COUNTER;
    reg [9:0] COUNT;
    reg SCLK;
    reg SDI;
    reg GO;
    wire reset_n;

    assign reset_n = KEY[0];
    assign I2C_SCLK = SCLK;
    assign I2C_SDAT = SDI ? 1'bz : 1'b0;
    assign SD_COUNTER_OUT = SD_COUNTER;

    always @(posedge CLOCK_50 or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n)
            COUNT <= 10'b0;
        else
            COUNT <= COUNT + 1'b1;
    end

    always @(posedge CLOCK_50 or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n)
            GO <= 1'b0;
        else if (KEY[1])
            GO <= 1'b1;
        else if (SD_COUNTER == 7'd31)
            GO <= 1'b0;
    end

    always @(posedge COUNT[9] or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n)
            SD_COUNTER <= 7'b1111111;
        else if (GO)
            SD_COUNTER <= SD_COUNTER + 1'b1;
    end

    always @(negedge COUNT[9] or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin
            SCLK <= 1'b1;
            SDI <= 1'b1;
        end
        else begin
            case (SD_COUNTER)
                7'd0  : SDI <= 1'b1;
                7'd1  : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd2  : SCLK <= 1'b0;
                7'd3  : SDI <= 1'b1;
                7'd4  : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd5  : SDI <= 1'b1;
                7'd6  : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd7  : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd8  : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd9  : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd10 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd11 : SDI <= 1'b1;
                7'd12 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd13 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd14 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd15 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd16 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd17 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd18 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd19 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd20 : SDI <= 1'b1;
                7'd21 : SDI <= 1'b1;
                7'd22 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd23 : SDI <= 1'b1;
                7'd24 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd25 : SDI <= 1'b1;
                7'd26 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd27 : SDI <= 1'b1;
                7'd28 : SDI <= 1'b0;
                7'd29 : SDI <= 1'b1;
                7'd30 : begin
                    SCLK <= 1'b1;
                    SDI <= 1'b0;
                end
                7'd31 : SDI <= 1'b1;
                default : begin
                    SCLK <= 1'b1;
                    SDI <= 1'b1;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    always @(posedge COUNT[9] or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n)
            SCLK <= 1'b1;
        else if ((SD_COUNTER >= 7'd4) && (SD_COUNTER <= 7'd31))
            SCLK <= ~SCLK;
    end

endmodule
